verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events and suggests hypotheses, which covers the telemetry-correlation core of the story. However, the evidence shows it is invoked on demand (tagging @betterstack, calling it from Slack, Teams or LLM workflows) rather than starting before a human asks. missing for 10: evidence of autonomous investigation that starts automatically when an incident fires, correlation with recent changes or deploys, matching against similar past incidents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
